calls.title: Thought Leadership Positioning
calls.summary: The team discussed the necessity of establishing GrowthBook as a leader in AI-driven experimentation to build trust and shorten sales cycles. Christian highlighted the need for strategic sales collateral that explains market shifts and GrowthBook's roadmap. This collateral aims to clarify GrowthBook's vision and competitive differentiation. Cris raised the importance of a unified stance on AI's role in experimentation, noting key buyer concerns about innovation after competitor acquisitions. Ryan emphasized creating thought leader content. Partnerships with Anthropic and other companies were identified as crucial for enhancing GrowthBook's credibility. The group also planned to address marketer needs by packaging AI features into user-friendly formats. They established the framework for tiered messaging to enable sales teams to communicate GrowthBook's AI capabilities consistently.
calls.keywords: AI in experimentation, thought leadership, sales positioning, GrowthBook roadmap, analytics automation, human in the loop
